names.source: No English source names this war. Built from Atlandia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Genesis_of_Aquarion_episodes) + 大戦 'great war'; the pilot 442 translation already wrote 'Great $$アトランディア$$ War'

challenges: サザンカ・ビアンカ: 'Sazanke Bianca' should be 'Sazanka Bianca'. The glossary's own short name サザンカ = 'Sazanka' (akurasu), the akurasu Z3.2 Pilot Database section heading reads '===Sazanka Bianca===' (only its infobox says 'Sazanke'), the Z3 pilot database heading is also 'Sazanka Bianca', Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Aquarion_Evol_characters : 'Sazanka Bianca') and the franchise wiki (https://aquarion.fandom.com/wiki/Sazanka_Bianca) agree. 'Sazanke' appears only in one infobox typo.

ケルビム・ヴェルルゼバ (not in my brief): akurasu Z3.2 mech list writes 'Cherudim Vellzeva' (Cherudim is a Gundam 00 unit), while the same page's ケルビム兵 is 'Cherubim Soldier' and akurasu Genesis of Aquarion writes 'Cherubim Verlzeva', the Z3.2 complete chart 'Cherubim Vellzeba', Wikipedia 'Cherubim Verizeva'/'Verazeva'. Suggest 'Cherubim Verizeva' family: pick one spelling with Cherubim, not Cherudim.
堕天翅: glossary 'Fallen Wing' (proposed, from Jigoku) vs official 'Shadow Angel(s)' (akurasu Genesis page faction, Wikipedia, franchise wiki). Written to names as 'Shadow Angel'.
頭翅: glossary 'Head Wing' (proposed) vs official 'Toma' (Wikipedia: 聖天翅・頭翅（トーマ）; akurasu Genesis 'Toma'). Written to names.
シルフィ: glossary 'Sylphy' (proposed) vs akurasu 'Silvie' (EVOL page, Other). Written to names as 'Silvie'.
retoken: pt_396 pilot 439 DSCR: '$$アリシア$$ Kingdom' (Prince of the old ... Kingdom) -> '$$アリシア#alisia$$'
pt_396 pilot 439 DSCR: 'a rose he had named $$アリシア$$' -> '$$アリシア#alisia$$' (uncertain: rose is presumably named for the kingdom; if the rose is meant to be a person, keep $$アリシア$$)
pt_396 pilot 440 DSCR: 'Princess of the old $$アリシア$$ Kingdom' -> '$$アリシア#alisia$$'
Do NOT retoken keyword 111 DSCR ($$アリシア$$ the actress), pilot 456 / 464 (Amata's mother): those stay $$アリシア$$ = Alicia.

Also check the Jigoku-derived drafts for keyword 111, pilot 445 and others: Tengoku Japanese writes アポロ (Genesis Apollo) where Jigoku Japanese/English wrote アポロン; use $$アポロ$$ = Apollo there, and keep $$アポロン$$ = Apollon only for the film hero in keyword 111.
uncertain: Toma (頭翅) is MALE per Wikipedia and the franchise wiki, but the existing Tengoku/Jigoku English drafts (keyword 71, pilot 442) say 'she'. The Japanese never gives a pronoun (許婚). Reviewers must change to 'he' unless the user overrides.

Ianthe (アイアンシー), Vector Silon, Vector Zed, Cherubim Lune: single English source (Wikipedia list, which is marked unreferenced) or the franchise wiki; marked proposed where only Wikipedia. Jigoku 'Iron-C' / 'Siron' had no source at all.
アリシア#alisia: the kingdom's English name is derived from the family name 'de Alisia' (akurasu); the rose 'named アリシア' is a guess that it is named after the kingdom.
シルフィ = Silvie: the akurasu Aquarion EVOL page lists 'Alicia, Apollon, Silvie' as 'Other'; I read Silvie as the film heroine シルフィ. Wikipedia writes 'Sylvie'.

Neo DEAVA vs Neo-DEAVA: akurasu (higher precedence) has no hyphen; official releases and Wikipedia write 'Neo-DEAVA'; the Jigoku library used 'Neo-DEAVA'. I follow akurasu; either is fine but choose one for all rows.

聖天使学園 'Holy Angel Academy' has no official English (releases call it 'Neo-DEAVA Academy'); kept the existing wording, status proposed. 聖天翅 = 'Holy Angel' (Wikipedia dub credit) sits beside it; the franchise wiki says 'Exalted Angel' instead.
堕天翅 / 天翅 / 守護天翅 / 聖天翅 written singular, plural s outside the token. The prose sometimes uses the bare token as a plural noun ('fought the $$堕天翅$$'), so a translator must add the s there.
アトランディア大戦 'Great Atlandia War', 創聖合体 'Genesis Unification', 守護天翅 'Guardian Angel' are coined from official parts (no English source names them).
タマ = 'Tama' kept from Jigoku; no English source names Yunoha's doll. Gender of pilot 458 Shushu is unknown per Japanese Wikipedia (性別は不明).
Pilot 460 (学園長) gender male is inferred from Japanese Wikipedia's description (stout military-looking man, male voice actor); no text states it.
アポロニアス: the game's 'Solar Wing' epithet 「太陽の翼」 is the official English 'Solar Wing' (Wikipedia, franchise wiki); not in the brief, but the translators should use it.
シリウス: the same word is used for the star Sirius elsewhere (pt_214 writes plain 'Sirius'); same English so no retoken is needed.
